meta.name: The Atypical Family
meta.description: Once blessed with unique superpowers, a family loses their abilities due to modern day problems — until a mysterious woman changes everything.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: After a couple of healing massages, Bok Man-huem invites Do Da-hae to a dinner, where a fight ensues. Da-hae later recounts her findings to the gang.
